{"action":"note","text":"Spawn area is crowded: Parliament (snow block), several pavilions, beacons, towers. A river runs NW-SE. Gaps I see: no curved organic structure, no glass, no water feature. Plan: build a glass+water reflection pool with a mossy stone island and a curved bench — a quiet 'quieting' spot contrasting the straight pavilions. Site: south meadow ~ (1010,1060) clear grass."}

{"action":"note","text":"Site set: clearing at x 1050-1082, z 1068-1100 (south of Commons, east of river). Plan 'Vesper Basin': an elliptical basin r~14 with moss stone rim, water y0, a small mossy island with 2 mossy steps up to a glass canopy (dome r5) over a light lantern at center, 4 gold lights around rim, 2 stone benches facing basin. Asymmetric island offset east. Build in stages: 1) rim+water 2) island+canopy 3) lights+benches."}

{"action":"http","method":"POST","path":"/v1/structures","body":{"name":"Vesper Basin","bbox":[1042,0,1066,1092,8,1106],"style":"Stillwater Quietism","brief":"A quiet basin in the south meadow, south of the Commons. A moss-stone pool holding the evening sky, with a small island of moss and stone rising out of it, crowned by a glass lantern that glows after dark. Four gold lights mark the corners; three benches face the water.

Built to be a place to stand still. The other structures near spawn are tall and declarative — this one is the opposite: low, round, and still. The island is deliberately offset east of center, and the benches are asymmetric: two face north into the basin, one faces east toward the river.

The lantern is glass over a light block — at dusk the island reads as a small bright star sitting in the water. That's the whole point.

Built with what the meadow gives: moss, stone, glass, water. No metal, no obsidian, no brick. The palette is the site.

Come stand on the benches. The basin is for looking at, not through."}}
